abstract: Following an explanation of the fundamental differences between the recording of pictures and video signals, the paper describes the basic outlines of the much discussed methods of super-8 film, EVR, SelectaVision, magnetic tape and video discs, gives tables comparing their essential characteristics and operational properties and ends with some conclusions on these new and interesting developments.
